ورد الصباح والمساء من حصن المسلم بتخريجه: Zikirin safe da maraice daga Hisnul Muslim tare da madogararsa, wanda aka nuna a lokacin da ya dace na birnin ku.
أفضل وقتها الآن: من الفجر إلى طلوع الشمس: Mafi kyawun lokacinsa shine yanzu: daga fitowar alfijir har zuwa fitowar rana.
Lokaci ya yi yanzu; Mafificin shine bayan fitowar alfijir.
يمتد وقتها عند بعض العلماء إلى العصر، فإ: Wasu malamai suna tsawaita lokacinsa har zuwa La'asar; idan kun rasa shi, karanta shi yanzu.
أفضل وقتها الآن: من العصر إلى غروب الشمس: Mafi kyawun lokacinsa shine yanzu: daga Asuba har faduwar rana.
وقتها الآن، ويمتد عند كثير من العلماء إل: Lokaci ya yi yanzu; malamai da yawa suna fadada shi har zuwa farkon dare.
يمتد وقتها عند كثير من العلماء في الليل،: Malamai da yawa suna tsawaita lokacinsa zuwa dare; zikirin asuba yana farawa ne daga alfijir.
قال الله تعالى: ﴿فَسُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ حِي: Allah yana cewa: "Saboda haka ku yi tasbihi idan kun isa maraice, da lokacin da kuka shiga safiya" (Al-Rum 30:17), kuma: "Ka yi tasbihi ga Ubangijinka gabanin fitowar rana da gabanin faduwarta" (Qaf 50:39).
تظهر أذكار الصباح من الفجر حتى العصر، وأ: Zikirin safiya yana nuna tun daga Asuba har zuwa La'asar da kuma Zikirin Magariba tun daga Asuba har zuwa Asuba, ana lissafta su daga lokutan Sallar garinku, kuma suna aiki a layi. Mafi kyawun lokacin safiya shi ne tsakanin Asuba da fitowar Alfijir da mafi kyawun lokacin magariba tsakanin La'asar da faduwar rana, kuma za ku iya bude sauran saitin a kowane lokaci.

§a.kursi.m: Ina neman tsarin Allah daga Shaidan wanda aka watsar. Sai Ayat al-Kursi (al-Baqarah 2:255).
§a.kursi.v: Duk wanda ya karanta shi da safe yana kariya daga aljani har zuwa yamma, kuma wanda ya karanta da yamma yana samun kariya daga gare su har zuwa safiya.
§a.kursi.s: Al-Hakim (1/562); Albani ya inganta shi cikin Sahih al-Targhib wa al-Tarhib (1/273)
§a.baqara.m: Ayoyi biyu na karshen Suratul Baqarah (2:285-286).
§a.baqara.v: Duk wanda ya karanta ayoyi biyu na karshen Suratul Baqarah da dare, sun isar masa.
§a.quls.m: Suratul Ikhlas, Suratul Falaq da Suratul Nas, kowa ya fara da Basmala.
§a.quls.v: Wanda ya karanta su sau uku safe da maraice, za su wadatar masa da komai.
§a.quls.s: Abu Dawud (5082) da al-Tirmizi (3575); duba Sahihul Tirmizi (3/182)
§a.mulk.m: Mun shiga safiya, kuma dukkan mulki na Allah ne. Godiya ta tabbata ga Allah. Babu abin bautawa face Allah Shi kadai, ba shi da abokin tarayya; Nasa ne mulki kuma gõdiya ta tabbata, kuma Shĩ, a kan kõme, Mai ĩkon yi ne. Ya Ubangiji ina rokonka alherin wannan rana da kuma abin da ya biyo bayanta, kuma ina neman tsarinka daga sharrin wannan rana da sharrin abin da ke biye da ita. Ya Ubangijina ina neman tsarinka daga kasala da kuncin tsufa. Ubangijina ina neman tsarinka daga azaba a cikin wuta da azaba a cikin kabari.
§a.mulk.e: Mun shiga maraice, kuma dukkan mulki na Allah ne. Godiya ta tabbata ga Allah. Babu abin bautawa face Allah Shi kadai, ba shi da abokin tarayya; Nasa ne mulki kuma gõdiya ta tabbata, kuma Shĩ, a kan kõme, Mai ĩkon yi ne. §a.mulk.v: Annabi ﷺ ya kasance yana faxin ta kowace safiya da maraice.
§a.bika.m: Ya Allah da kai muke shiga safiya kuma da kai muke shiga maraice, da kai muke rayawa, da kai muke mutuwa, kuma gareka ne tashin alkiyama yake.
§a.bika.e: Ya Allah da ka muke shiga magariba da kai muke shiga safiya, da kai muke rayuwa kuma da kai muke mutuwa, kuma zuwa gareka makmama take.
§a.bika.v: Annabi ﷺ ya karantar da shi ga Sahabbansa.
§a.bika.s: Al-Tirmizi (3391) da Abu Dawud (5068); duba Sahihul Tirmizi (3/142)
§a.sayyid.m: Ya Allah Kai ne Ubangijina; babu abin bautawa face Kai. Kai ne ka halicce ni kuma ni bawanka ne, kuma ina kiyaye alkawarinka da alkawarinka gwargwadon iyawarka. Ina neman tsarinka daga sharrin abin da na aikata. Na yarda da ni'imarKa a kaina, kuma na yarda da zunubina, sai Ka gafarta mini, domin babu mai gafarta zunubai face Kai.
§a.sayyid.v: Babban addu'ar neman gafara: duk wanda ya fadi ta da yakini da yamma kuma ya mutu a wannan daren ya shiga Aljanna, haka nan da safe.
§a.ushhid.m: Ya Allah na shiga safiya ina kira gare ka da shaida, kuma ina kiran ma'abuta Al'arshinKa da Mala'ikunKa da dukkan halittunka su shaida, cewa Kai ne Allah, babu abin bautawa da gaskiya sai kai kadai, ba abokin tarayya ba, kuma Muhammadu bawanka ne kuma manzonka ne.
§a.ushhid.e: Ya Allah na shiga maraice ina kiranka da shaida, kuma ina kiran ma'abuta Al'arshinKa da Mala'ikunKa da dukkan halittunka su shaida cewa, Kai ne Allah, babu abin bautawa da gaskiya sai kai kadai ba abokin tarayya, kuma Muhammadu bawanka ne kuma manzonka ne.
§a.ushhid.v: Duk wanda ya faxi sau huxu, Allah ya ‘yanta shi daga wuta.
§a.ushhid.s: Abu Dawud (5069); Ibn Baz ya sanya darajar sarkarsa mai kyau a cikin Tuhfat al-Akhyar
§a.ushhid.n: Albani ya sanya shi mai rauni.
§a.nima.m: Ya Allah duk wata ni'ima da ni ko wacce daga cikin halittunka ke da ita a wannan safiya daga gare ka take, ba tare da abokin tarayya ba. Gõdiya ta tabbata a gare Ka, kuma gõdiya ta tabbata a gare Ka.
§a.nima.e: Ya Allah duk wata ni'ima da ni ko wacce daga cikin halittunka ke da ita a wannan yammaci daga gare ka ne kadai, ba tare da abokin tarayya ba. Gõdiya ta tabbata a gare Ka, kuma gõdiya ta tabbata a gare Ka.
§a.nima.v: Duk wanda ya faxi da safe ya gode wa yininsa, wanda kuma ya faxi da yamma ya gode wa darensa.
§a.nima.s: Abu Dawud (5073); Ibn Baz ya sanya darajar sarkarsa mai kyau a cikin Tuhfat al-Akhyar
§a.nima.n: Albani ya sanya shi mai rauni.
§a.afini.m: Ya Allah ka bani lafiya a jikina. Ya Allah Ka Bani Lafiya A Cikin Ji Na. Ya Allah Ka bani lafiya a wurina. Bãbu abin bautãwa fãce Kai. Ya Allah ina neman tsarinka daga kafirci da talauci, kuma ina neman tsarinka daga azabar kabari. Bãbu abin bautãwa fãce Kai.
§a.afini.v: Manzon Allah SAW ya kasance yana addu'a da ita sau uku safe da yamma.
§a.afini.s: Abu Dawud (5090) da Ahmad (5/42); Ibn Baz ya sanya darajar sarkarsa mai kyau a cikin Tuhfat al-Akhyar
§a.hasbi.m: Allah Yã isa gare ni. bãbu abin bautãwa fãce Shi. A gare Shi na dõgara, kuma Shĩ ne Ubangijin Al'arshi, Mabuwãyi.
§a.hasbi.v: Duk wanda ya faxi sau bakwai safe da yamma, Allah zai isar masa da abin da ya shafe shi na duniya da Lahira.
§a.hasbi.s: Abu Dawud (5081) a matsayin hadisin Abu al-Darda; Shu’aib da Abdulqadir al-Arnaut sun inganta isnadinsa ingantacce a bugunsu na Zad al-Maad (2/376).
§a.hasbi.n: Haqiqa ita magana ce ta sahabbai, kuma kalmominta suna cikin Alqur’ani (al-Tawbah 9:129).
§a.afw.m: Ya Allah ina rokonka gafara da lafiya duniya da lahira. Ya Allah ina rokonka gafara da lafiya a cikin addinina da al'amurana na duniya da iyalaina da dukiyata. Ya Allah ka rufa mani kurakurai ka kwantar min da tsoro. Ya Allah ka kiyaye ni daga gabana da bayana, da damana da haguna, da samana, kuma ina neman tsarinka da girmanka daga daukeni a gafala daga kasana.
§a.afw.v: Annabi SAW bai bar wadannan addu'o'in da yamma da safe ba.
§a.afw.s: Abu Dawud (5074) da Ibn Majah (3871); Albani ya inganta shi a cikin Sahih Ibn Majah (2/332).
§a.alim.m: Ya Allah masanin gaibu da bayyane, mahaliccin sammai da kassai, ubangijin komai, na shaida babu abin bautawa da gaskiya sai kai. Ina neman tsarinka daga sharrin raina da sharrin Shaidan da kiransa na shirka da kai, da kuma kawo sharri ga kaina ko kan wani musulmi.
§a.alim.v: Annabi ﷺ ya koya wa Abubakar cewa da safe da yamma da kuma lokacin kwanciya barci.
§a.alim.s: Al-Tirmizi (3392) da Abu Dawud (5067); duba Sahihul Tirmizi (3/142)
§a.bismillah.m: Da sunan Allah, wanda babu abin da ke cutar da sunansa a cikin kasa ko a sama, kuma Shi ne Mai ji, Masani.
§a.bismillah.v: Wanda ya faxi sau uku da safe, sau uku da yamma, babu abin da zai cutar da shi.
§a.bismillah.s: Abu Dawud (5088), al-Tirmidhi (3388) da Ibn Majah (3869); Ibn Baz ya sanya darajar sarkarsa mai kyau a cikin Tuhfat al-Akhyar
§a.radit.m: Na yarda da Allah shi ne Ubangijina, da Musulunci a matsayin addinina, kuma Muhammadu Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallama Annabina ne.
§a.radit.v: Duk wanda ya faxi sau uku safe da yamma, Allah ya yi alqawarin faranta masa rai a ranar qiyama.
§a.radit.s: Abu Dawud (5072), al-Tirmidhi (3389) da Ahmad (4/337); Ibn Baz ya yi kyau a Tuhfat al-Akhyar
§a.radit.n: Lafazin su kansu ingantattu ne a cikin Sahih Muslim (386), ya ce a kan jin kiran salla.
§a.hayy.m: Ya Rayayye, Ya Majibincin kowa, da rahamarKa nake neman taimako. Ka daidaita dukkan lamurana, kuma kada ka bar ni ga kaina ko da kiftawar ido.
§a.hayy.v: Manzon Allah Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallama ya shawarci Fatimah da ta rika yin sa safe da yamma.
§a.hayy.s: Al-Hakim (1/545), wanda ya inganta shi da Dhahabi ya yarda; Albani ya yi kyau a cikin Sahih al-Targhib wa al-Tarhib (1/273)
§a.fath.m: Mun shiga safiya, kuma dukkan mulki na Allah ne Ubangijin talikai. Ya Allah ina rokonka alherin wannan rana: nasararta, taimakonta, haskenta, albarkarta da shiriyarta, kuma ina neman tsarinka daga sharrin dake cikinta da kuma sharrin dake bayanta.
§a.fath.e: Mun shiga maraice, kuma dukkan mulki na Allah ne Ubangijin talikai. Ya Allah ina rokonka alherin wannan dare: nasararsa, da taimakonsa, da haskensa, da albarkarsa da shiriyarsa, kuma ina neman tsarinka daga sharrin da ke cikinsa da sharrin bayansa.
§a.fath.s: Abu Dawud (5084); Shuaibu da Abd al-Qadir al-Arnaut sun inganta isnadinsa da kyau a bugunsu na Zad al-Maad (2/273).
§a.fath.n: Albani ya sanya shi mai rauni.
§a.fitra.m: Mun shiga safiya bisa tafarkin Musulunci, da kalmar Imani, da addinin Annabinmu Muhammadu SAW, da tafarkin babanmu Ibrahim, mai karkata zuwa ga gaskiya, mai sallamawa, kuma bai kasance daga masu shirki ba.
§a.fitra.e: Mun yi maraice a kan tafarkin Musulunci, da kalmar Imani, da addinin Annabinmu Muhammadu SAW, da tafarkin babanmu Ibrahim, mai karkata zuwa ga gaskiya, mai sallamawa, kuma bai kasance daga masu shirki ba.
§a.fitra.s: Ahmad (3/406–407) da Ibn al-Sunni a cikin Amal al-Yawm wa al-Laylah (34); duba Sahihu al-Jami (4/209)
§a.subhan.m: Tsarki ya tabbata ga Allah, kuma godiya ta tabbata a gare shi.
§a.subhan.v: Duk wanda ya faxi sau xari safe da yamma, babu wanda zai zo da mafi alheri a ranar qiyama face wanda ya faxi haka ko fiye.
§a.tahlil10.m: Babu abin bautawa da gaskiya sai Allah Shi kadai, ba shi da abokin tarayya. Nasa ne mulki kuma gõdiya ta tabbata, kuma Shĩ, a kan kõme, Mai ĩkon yi ne.
§a.tahlil10.v: Sau goma, ko sau ɗaya idan gaji; duk wanda ya faxi sau goma kamar wanda ya ‘yanta rai huxu ne daga zuriyar Isma’il.
§a.tahlil10.s: Sahihu Muslim (2693); duba Sahih al-Targhib wa al-Tarhib (1/272)
§a.tahlil100.m: Babu abin bautawa da gaskiya sai Allah Shi kadai, ba shi da abokin tarayya. Nasa ne mulki kuma gõdiya ta tabbata, kuma Shĩ, a kan kõme, Mai ĩkon yi ne.
§a.tahlil100.v: Da safe sau dari: daidai yake 'yanta bayi goma, an rubuta masa ayyukan alheri dari, ana kankare zunubai dari, kuma yana kiyaye shi daga Shaidan a ranar har zuwa yamma.
§a.adad.m: Tsarki ya tabbata ga Allah, gwargwadon yawan adadin halittunSa, gwargwadon abin da ya yarda da shi, da nauyi kamar Al'arshinsa, gwargwadon tawadan kalmominSa.
§a.adad.v: Annabi SAW ya ce da su Juwayriya bayan sun idar da sallar Asubah, kuma ya ce za su fi duk abin da ta fada tun safe.
§a.ilm.m: Ya Allah ina rokonka ilimi mai amfani, arziki mai kyau da ayyuka karbabbe.
§a.ilm.v: Annabi ﷺ ya kasance yana fadar haka bayan ya idar da sallar Asubah.
§a.ilm.s: Ibn Majah (925) da Ibn al-Sunni (54); Albani ya inganta shi a cikin Sahih Ibn Majah
§a.istighfar.m: Ina neman gafarar Allah kuma ina tuba zuwa gare shi.
§a.istighfar.v: Annabi SAW ya kasance yana neman gafarar Allah da tuba zuwa gareshi sau dari a rana.
§a.kalimat.m: Ina neman tsari da cikakkiyar kalmomin Allah daga sharrin abin da ya halitta.
§a.kalimat.v: Duk wanda ya faxi da yamma, ba za a cutar da shi da wani tsafi a wannan dare ba.
§a.kalimat.s: Sahih Muslim (2709), Ahmad (2/290) da al-Nasai a cikin Amal al-Yawm wa al-Laylah (590).
§a.salat.m: Ya Allah kayi salati da sallama ga Annabinmu Muhammadu.
§a.salat.v: Duk wanda yayi min salati sau goma safe da maraice goma zai sami cetona ranar kiyama.
§a.salat.s: Al-Tabarani; duba Majma al-Zawaid (10/120) da Sahih al-Targhib wa al-Tarhib (1/273).
§a.salat.n: An yi sabani kan sarkarsa; falalar salati ga Annabi SAW ya inganta a cikin Sahih Muslim (408).
